# Construction sites of private firms: they hold the slot (and the rural district) while
# a firm is built, bought into a district or restructured. No jobs, no housing. They can be
# cleared like a small firm (Guided and Mixed economy).

	is_for_colonizable = yes

	time = 180

	can_be_cleared = { exists = owner owner = { OR = { has_policy_flag = pe_order_guided has_policy_flag = pe_order_mixed } } }
